text.p: The Stack Usage view shows the remaining stack space of each task, which allows for optimizing the memory usage and for reducing the risk of occational stack overflows.

Note that this feature is only available for some target platforms. Check for a "Stack Usage" section in the platform-specific documentation under Creating and Loading Traces/[YourTargetPlatform] to learn more. In case this is not available, the Stack Usage analysis is not yet supported for your target platform.
